description: This file is a React-like component written in TSX using the Qwik framework. It implements the main notes interface with UI components, state management, API calls, and user interactions for a notes application.

methods.name: refresh$
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the server and updates the local state, with initial loading and error handling.

methods.name: onAddNote$
methods.description: Creates a new note with optimistic UI update, then syncs with server and handles errors.

methods.name: onSelect$
methods.description: Sets the currently selected note ID.

methods.name: onDelete$
methods.description: Deletes a note both locally and on the server, with rollback on failure.

methods.name: onSave$
methods.description: Saves updates to a note with optimistic UI, reverting if server update fails.

methods.name: onSearch$
methods.description: Performs search queries to filter notes and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the current list of notes, filtered if applicable.
